items.summary: ゲーム音楽が流れる中庭，ゲーム機や原画が並ぶ教室，初対面の人と楽しむ謎解き。「TheTenthMosaic」には，ゲームとアートを日常の延長で楽しめる空間が広がっていた。展示や企画を巡りながら過ごした2日間を振り返る。

zh.title: 一个略带神秘又舒适的空间，游戏与艺术融入日常生活。在“第十马赛克”度过的两天报告【第十马赛克】
zh.summary: 播放游戏音乐的庭院，摆满游戏机和原创图画的教室，与你从未见过的人一起解开谜团。 “TheTenthMosaic”拥有宽敞的空间，您可以在这里享受游戏和艺术，作为日常生活的延伸。回顾这两天的展览和项目参观。

en.title: A slightly mysterious and comfortable space where games and art blend into everyday life. Report on the two days spent at “The Tenth Mosaic” [The Tenth Mosaic]
en.summary: A courtyard with game music playing, a classroom lined with game consoles and original drawings, and solving mysteries with people you've never met before. ``TheTenthMosaic'' has a spacious space where you can enjoy games and art as an extension of your daily life. Looking back on the two days spent touring the exhibitions and projects.

items.title: 第10の芸術・ゲームを辿る。ゲームの歴史と多様な表現を巡るイベントで見えてきた，インディペンデントな創作精神の系譜［The Tenth Mosaic］
items.summary: 往年のゲーム機にゲームのアート，インディーゲーム。カルチャーイベント「TheTenthMosaic」には，時代やジャンルの垣根を越え，多彩なゲームと表現が集まった。イベントに参加して見えてきた，作り手たちの精神とそのつながりを考える。

zh.title: 遵循第十艺术/游戏。通过围绕游戏历史的事件和多样化表达揭示的独立创作精神的谱系【第十马赛克】
zh.summary: 旧游戏机上的游戏艺术和独立游戏。文化活动“TheTenthMosaic”汇集了超越时代和流派界限的各种游戏和表现形式。通过参与活动，思考创作者的精神以及他们之间的联系。

en.title: Follow the 10th art/game. The genealogy of the independent creative spirit revealed through events surrounding the history of games and diverse expression [The Tenth Mosaic]
en.summary: Game art and indie games on old game consoles. The cultural event ``TheTenthMosaic'' brought together a wide variety of games and expressions that transcended the boundaries of era and genre. Think about the spirit of the creators and the connections between them, as seen by participating in the event.

items.summary: 「TheTenthMosaic」で行われた「Rez」25周年記念トークセッションは，ゲーム史のみならず，90年代のテクノ・エレクトロ史を振り返る貴重な機会となった。シナスタジアへの挑戦とテクノアーティストたちとの交流。水口哲也氏やケン・イシイ氏らが語った，ゲームと音楽が交わった制作の舞台裏をお届けする。

zh.title: 90年代游戏与techno的邂逅，发生在《Rez》的制作现场。水口哲也谈“玩家创作音乐的游戏”的挑战【第十张马赛克】
zh.summary: 在“TheTenthMosaic”举办的“Rez”25 周年纪念讲座是一个宝贵的机会，不仅可以回顾游戏的历史，还可以回顾 20 世纪 90 年代的 techno 和 electro 的历史。接受联觉的挑战并与科技艺术家互动。我们为您带来水口哲也、石井健等人讲述的游戏与音乐交叉的幕后制作。

en.title: The encounter between 90's games and techno that took place at the production site of "Rez". Tetsuya Mizuguchi talks about the challenge of “a game where players create music” [The Tenth Mosaic]
en.summary: The ``Rez'' 25th anniversary talk session held at ``TheTenthMosaic'' was a valuable opportunity to look back not only at the history of games, but also the history of techno and electro in the 1990s. Taking on the challenge of Synesthesia and interacting with techno artists. We bring you a behind-the-scenes look at the production where games and music intersect, as told by Tetsuya Mizuguchi, Ken Ishii, and others.

en.title: ``The Midnight Barber'' is a narrative ADV that uses rhythm to uncover information about incidents hidden behind the city. The customers who come to the barber shop late at night are fairies and werewolves.

zh.title: 体验不分黑白的人际关系和选择的重量！看看来自加泰罗尼亚的学校生活模拟游戏“Skool Days”[游玩报告]

en.title: Experience the weight of human relationships and choices that cannot be divided into black and white! Check out the school life sim “Skool Days” from Catalonia [Play Report]
en.summary: At SAGABarcelonaGameFest2026, I checked out ``SkoolDays'', a social simulator set in a school, created by Catalonia-based CocodroloGames. ja.title: 「Horizo​​n」のベテランが「Skins」の脚本家を招いたとき、ついにプロットレーシングゲームが待っていた？
ja.summary: 著者: Bai Yazhou レース ゲーム カテゴリに真の「ゲームブレイカー」が登場してから長い時間が経ちました。もちろん、これは今日の市場に優れたレーシング ゲームが存在しないと言っているわけではありません。 「周回速度を上げる」ためにシミュレーションをプレイしたい場合でも、「景色を楽しむ」ためにオープンワールドをプレイしたい場合でも、選択肢はあります。しかし私個人としては、友人とレース ゲームについて話すとき、子供の頃に「ニード フォー スピード モスト ウォンテッド」をプレイした衝撃的な体験が今でも思い出されます。危険で刺激的で、ゲームをプレイしているとまるで映画を見ているかのようでした。このことについてマイク・ブラウンとベン・ペンローズに話したとき、彼らも故意に微笑んだ。まずはそれらを紹介しましょう。彼らは、『Forza Horizo​​n』シリーズの元クリエイティブ ディレクター（マイク ブラウン）とアート ディレクター（ベン ペンローズ）です。現在、彼らは約 40 人の元 Playground Games の退役軍人を連れてきています。

en.title: When the "Horizon" veteran invited the screenwriter of "Skins", we finally waited for a plot racing game?
en.summary: Author: Bai Yazhou It’s been a long time since we saw a true “game-breaker” in the racing game category. Of course, this is not to say that there is a lack of excellent racing games on the market today. Whether you want to play simulation to "increase full lap speed" or want to play an open world to "appreciate the scenery", you still have options. But for me personally, when talking about racing games with friends, I can still think of the shocking experience of playing "Need for Speed: Most Wanted" when I was a child. It was dangerous and exciting, and playing the game was like watching a movie. When talking to Mike Brown and Ben Penrose about this, they also smiled knowingly. Let me introduce them first. They are the former creative director (Mike Brown) and art director (Ben Penrose) of the "Forza Horizon" series. Now, they bring about 40 former Playground Games veterans.

ja.title: MLBB 10 周年: 真のグローバル化とは何ですか?

en.title: MLBB 10th Anniversary: ​​What is true globalization?
en.summary: From October 9th to 11th, the tenth anniversary celebrations of "Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (hereinafter referred to as MLBB)" were held simultaneously in ten countries around the world. The theme of the celebration is "All In MLBB", and the event spans three continents: Asia, Europe and the United States. During this period, you can see MLBB’s classic elements appearing on the streets in Indonesia and Turkey, and you can also see a giant birthday cake in Bangkok, Thailand; you can see MLBB’s 133 Cosplayers at a performance in Malaysia, and you can also see developers in Russia communicating with players in front of the big screen. The most intuitive thing at the scene is the flow of people. There are always so many people. In some places, the excitement is even close to that of a small concert. And then there is a strong regional identity: scroll through the social media discussions related to the MLBB celebrations, and you will see players with different languages, skin colors, and looks.
